svg.title: Keep cohort membership fixed through retirement
svg.desc: Constructed millisecond timeline • one executor • no implementation
svg.text: Keep cohort membership fixed through retirement
Constructed millisecond timeline • one executor • no implementation
Seal A/B/C at 3 ms
Receipts A0, B1, C3; max three requests
Prefill ends 5; output lengths 2,4,1
D4 and E6 wait for the next cohort
Finish members independently
5: C terminal; 6: A terminal; 8: B terminal
Useful selections by round: 3,2,1,1
Inactive slots do not admit D or E
Logical terminal is not retirement
All members terminal 8; reader live to 9
Retain protected cohort state and claims
Only at 9 may D/E seal their cohort
A timer cannot bound busy waiting
Oldest D receipt 4 + timer 4 = 8
Executor unavailable through retirement 9
D queue wait 5 ms exceeds timer 4 ms
Static membership can coexist with streaming and early per-request terminal delivery.
A completion mask preserves semantics; it does not prove physical work was skipped.
